topic: 浮卡滚动失效（手势系统/隐藏规则/canvas 手势注册表）
text:
**用户：**
浮卡依然不行，你看这个日志，我发现它好像只有水平方向，没有垂直方向[13:36:58.773] [swipe] dx: 0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.796] [swipe] dx: 0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.803] [swipe] dx: 0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.812] [swipe] dx: 0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.823] [swipe] dx: 0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.828] [swipe] dx: -0 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.836] [swipe] dx: -0 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.845] [swipe] dx: -0 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.853] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.861] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.870] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.879] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.886] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.892] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:36:58.893] [gesture] END, type: pointerup handler: gestures-page-swipe dx: -1 → [13:36:59.897] [gesture] END, type: pointerup handler: gestures-page-swipe dx: 0

**AI：**
这才是真正的根因。之前所有 `touch-action` 修复都是必要条件，但不充分。

**真正的问题**：`gestures-page-swipe` 处理器（优先级 50）在捕获浮卡内的所有触摸事件。它的 `targetFilter` 排除了 `.light-orb` 和 `.stack-card`，但**漏了 `.floating-card`**。

日志里 `[swipe] dx: -0 axis: vertical` 就是证据——手指在浮卡内垂直滑动，被页面滑动手势拦截了，浏览器根本没机会处理原生滚动。

```
修复前: target.closest('.floating-card')  → 没排除 → gestures-page-swipe 抢走触摸 → 滚不了
修复后: 加上 !target.closest('.floating-card') → 手势放过 → 浏览器接管 pan-y 滚动
```

跟 `.light-orb` 和 `.stack-card` 的排除逻辑完全一致，就是当初加这两个的时候忘了浮卡。
